findings.text: the plan's §21 node 3 proposes "one predicate both async sites call" for the local-model test but does not name `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES`, the existing module constant that already defines the local-prefix set (`ollama/`, `local/`, `hosted_vllm/`, `openai/localhost`) and is already the owner used by `ensure_model_prefix` and `_acompletion_local`'s prefix strip; the plan also undercounts the duplication it is fixing — it says the test "is already written out twice" when the inline `model.startswith(("local/", "hosted_vllm/"))` appears three times (`llm.py:2102` in `_build_kwargs`, `:2376` in `acall_llm_structured`, `:2832` in `_acall_frozen_structured_transport`)

findings.reason: the plan should name `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES` as the owner and make the routing predicate consume it, which also fixes the `ollama/`/`openai/localhost` gap and covers the third inline site at line 2102.
findings.text: the plan adds a predicate for the local-model decision instead of extending `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES`, the file that already owns "which prefixes are local", so the routing test and the prefix-strip in `_acompletion_local` will resolve local-ness from two definitions that today differ

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §21 node 3 hides the local/remote decision behind one predicate and one request-translation function shared by the sync and async paths, and §14 landed one `render_path_prefix_clause` renderer embedding the prefix predicate for seven call sites; both are interfaces smaller than the behaviour they hide.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the new local-routing predicate duplicates the concept already owned by `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES` at `imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:879`; the plan should extend that constant rather than add a second definition of "which model prefixes are local".
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied figures public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §21 adds no member of those four families (its new surface is model-seat config) and its own text names what it retires: the `language` and `vision` seats from `MODEL_SECTIONS`, `_MODEL_DEFAULTS`, `_MODEL_ENV_VARS` and `pyproject.toml`, and the four `tests/core/test_settings.py` tests that bind them.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites prior art well for the seat split (§21 names `[tool.imas-codex.sn-compose]`, `get_model`, `register_model_endpoints`, `get_reasoning_effort`) and for §14 (`render_path_prefix_clause`, `seed_facility_roots`, `discovery_roots`, `reset_to_option`), but for the LLM local-routing predicate it proposes a new predicate without naming the existing owner of that concept, `_LOCAL_MODEL_PREFIXES`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the new synchronous local client is a justified extension, not an unjustified parallel layer: the plan states that `_get_local_client` returns a pooled `AsyncOpenAI` and `_acompletion_local` builds its request inline, so the async helpers cannot serve `call_llm_structured` as they stand.
